description: Each picture and video in the ads (with its id) with its own last-30-day results (spend, results, CTR, cost per result), a verdict (good, ok, weak, untested, unused, new) judged among that account's own creatives, whether it is live, whether it matches the current offer, and for videos what was watched: the hook, the offer, voice and on-screen words. Unfiltered, it also lists what was made or uploaded in the last 7 days (latestMade, newest first, even with no spend yet) and what is still being made (inProgress): read it before saying a new ad hasn't arrived. Files that arrived in the last 2 days but aren't ready yet (a video still being prepared) are in `processing`, with their kind and state: a file there arrived, never say it is missing. Useful for 'which creatives work?', 'which video is best?', 'what should I replace?'.

account.description: An ad account's name, to look at one account; omit for all of them.

compact.description: true: short rows (id, title, kind, account, verdict, live, spend, results), so many fit in one answer.

id.description: Only this creative: its id, e.g. the one the owner is looking at.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

limit.description: How many to list (default 15, at most 100). Over 30, pass compact too.

live.description: true: only creatives in an ad that runs now.

offset.description: Skip this many first (the next page: offset = the previous offset + shown).

name: get_creatives

error.description: Why nothing was done, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Creatives and their results
